subject: info-af-b
title: INFO.AF.B.------CR.INFO.DY.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-35, second of two on book p179. (C)INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is the subject in a multi-hub network with no single dominant center. Nodes include STF (source transfer), MT-INFO (multi-information), CRT-F-D (criticism factor dynamics), APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions), C-CONT (composite continuance), CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts), ALT-F (alternative functionalism), CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis), CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics), LANG-DY (language dynamics), COS-D (cosmic dictates). Multiple cross-connections form a network of mutual constitution rather than a single hierarchical structure. Structural argument: information affinity basis sits in a network where the constituting forces (criticism factor dynamics, applied redefinitions, cultural transfer shifts, circular information dynamics, language dynamics) all mutually shape each other — exposing Braxton's diagnostic that western information affinity basis is structurally networked, not hierarchical, which is precisely why the curation apparatus is so resistant to single-point challenges. To shift one node requires shifting the entire mutual-constitution layer.
